outcome.objective: Materialize a complete provider-neutral worker commission from a compact Web CEO request through the existing Mastermind Craft compiler.
outcome.why: Web delegation should originate from small structured CEO intent while independent workers receive enough bounded context to execute without replaying the parent transcript.
outcome.user_journey: A Web CEO states the bounded outcome and proof contract once; the host compiler creates the complete commission; the existing publication seam stores exact bytes for the worker to read.
outcome.machine_outcome: Deterministic commission bytes and a stable digest are produced without selecting a provider, model, account, credential, host, worker, or lifecycle.

non_goals: Do not create a second brief compiler or worker lifecycle.
Do not alter Executive admission, provider routing, credentials, queues, retries, or worker identity.
Do not modify the separate Session 2 commission-source branch.

inputs: This compact CEO request and its exact acceptance contract.
The existing Craft common method plus exactly the selected role method.
The downstream fixed publication target research/executive_commissions/COMMISSION.md owned outside this compiler.

data.time: Source and governing references are exact commit identities; later protected-master movement requires explicit reconciliation.
data.missing: Unknown runtime admission, provider eligibility, workspace binding, and host binding remain unknown rather than being inferred.
data.corrections: Any compact input or method-byte change produces a new digest; corrected commissions do not erase prior evidence.
data.rights: Use repository-owned method text and bounded non-secret task data only; never embed credentials or private transcripts.

deterministic: Validate the closed compact schema, exact commit identities, relative write paths, bounded lists, and non-secret opaque authority reference.
Expand compact fields into the incumbent mastermind.craft_brief.v1 contract and compile common plus exactly one role method.
Render fixed commission sections and hash the exact UTF-8 commission bytes.
model: Use model judgment only inside the supplied bounded worker method; the compiler itself performs no model inference or routing.
implementation_order: Validate compact CEO intent and fail closed on missing authority, source, acceptance, or unknown routing fields.
Normalize through the existing complete-brief schema without choosing a provider, model, account, credential, host, or worker.
Compile the selected Craft method and deterministic commission sections.
Return exact commission bytes and digest for the existing fixed COMMISSION.md publication seam.

deliverables: A complete provider-neutral worker commission suitable for the fixed Session 2 COMMISSION.md path.
A deterministic receipt containing compact-input, normalized-brief, method, and commission digests.
acceptance: The representative compact fixture compiles byte-for-byte to the checked-in golden commission.
The checked-in golden receipt commission_sha256 equals the SHA-256 of those exact bytes.
Removing authority_ref, source, or acceptance fails closed before compilation.
Adding provider, model, account, credential, host, or worker selection fields is refused as an unknown compact field.

refusals: Refuse malformed or incomplete authority/source/proof input rather than inventing missing company state.
Refuse any caller attempt to smuggle provider, model, account, credential, host, or worker selection into the compact compiler.
Refuse source or method files that violate the existing bounded-file and link-safety checks.
stop_conditions: Stop before effects if current source ownership conflicts with another writer.
Stop dependent work on EFFECT_UNKNOWN until the original carrier is reconciled.
Stop at an external release protection only after all path-disjoint implementation and local proof are complete.

constraints: The compiler is an authoring utility and grants no execution, runtime, workspace, or deployment authority.
The full parent transcript is not an input to this contract.
The fixed downstream publication path remains owned by the existing Web commission-source integration.

continuation.record_owner: GitHub implementation and evidence stay on the incumbent Craft PR stack.
continuation.next_action: Pass the compiled commission bytes and digest to the existing Session 2 fixed COMMISSION.md publication seam without selecting a provider or widening authority.
